item.title: Sam Altman downplays Moltbook hype, highlights OpenClaw as next big shift in AI
item.description: Sam Altman played down the hype around Moltbook but said OpenClaw shows how autonomous AI agents could reshape everyday computing. Speaking in San Francisco, the OpenAI chief stressed that self-operating software is a lasting shift, even if viral platforms fade.

item.title: Stop normalising long gaps between periods, oncologist links it to uterine cancer
item.description: A healthy menstrual cycle depends on a balance between estrogen and progesterone. Estrogen stimulates the growth of the uterine lining, while progesterone helps regulate this growth and allows the lining to shed during menstruation. When periods are infrequent, ovulation often does not occur regularly.

item.title: Pakistani forces physically ‘handicapped’ in Balochistan, admits Khawaja Asif as violence rages
item.description: The Pakistan Defence Minister’s comment comes amid a surge in militant violence, including recent BLA attacks claiming many lives. He rejected talks with “terrorists,” while Balochistan continues to suffer from poverty and demands for autonomy.
